category_edits.rationale: Test whether increasing causal recent-four-state pooling from 0.2 to 0.35 improves recent-context smoothing across all four datasets. Apply the same readout during training and inference, preserving the backbone, checkpoint shapes and all other settings.

change_summary: Increase recent-four-state pooling to 35% for every training position and final-real-position inference. Synchronize saved metadata and the embedded predictor's compatibility check.
